_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: CLEAN POP PLAZA planter, 6.0 wide x 4.0 deep, bushes up to 5.6. Origin on the floor under the middle; long side along X. Tint the bushes per planter (sky / mint / lilac / peach). Suggested: between benches, either side of the hall steps, and at the booth row ends. Textures: the shared Hub_CleanProps_* 512 set (lamp, bench and planter use the same three maps).
